meta.name: google-ads-landing
meta.description: Score and diagnose Google Ads landing pages. Use when asked to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, diagnose high-CTR but low-conversion-rate ad groups, improve Quality Score's Landing Page Experience component, or compare an ad group's messaging against its landing page. Trigger on "landing page audit", "landing page score", "landing page quality", "why is my conversion rate low", "LPX", "landing page experience", "ad to page match", or when `/google-ads-audit` surfaces a high-CTR / low-CVR ad group.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断谷歌广告落地页质量并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在投放谷歌广告，想提升落地页体验和转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Google Ads landing page quality and get optimization tips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Google Ads and want to improve landing page experience and conversion rates.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会抓取落地页并调用 PageSpeed Insights，结合广告文案和转化数据，按消息匹配、页面速度、移动体验、信任信号、表单与 CTA 五个维度评分，输出诊断报告（最大问题、修复建议、预计月收益），并记录历史。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计或评分落地页、诊断高点击率低转化的广告组，或提到“landing page audit”、“LPX”等关键词时触发；也可能由 `/google-ads-audit` 自动交接。

say.note: 将按五个维度评分并给出修复建议。

say.text: 为什么广告点击率高但转化低？
say.note: 会检查广告与落地页匹配度并诊断原因。

say.text: 对比这个广告组和它的落地页是否匹配
say.note: 提取广告标题与页面 H1 做匹配判定。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches the landing page and PageSpeed data, scores five dimensions against ad copy/conversions, and outputs a report with biggest leak, top fixes, estimated monthly lift; then logs to history.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks to audit/score a landing page, diagnose high-CTR/low-CVR ad groups, or mentions keywords like 'landing page audit', 'LPX', etc.; also on auto-handoff from /google-ads-audit.

say_en.note: Scores it on five dimensions and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Why are my ads high-CTR but low CVR?
say_en.note: Checks ad-page match and diagnoses causes.

say_en.text: Does this ad group's messaging match its landing page?
say_en.note: Compares ad headlines with page H1 for a verdict.
